digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI / Gerrit Verified workflow
propositions: Gerrit Verified dispatch-triggered workflow saturates the Actions runner pool during burst periods with 22+ waiting jobs and 14-23 minute queue delays, not tickets-branch pushes

Current workflow shape executes 17–24 runner jobs per patchset (full route with up to 7 mutation shards), creating 13-job immediate fan-out that exceeds Free plan 20-job concurrency ceiling when three independent patchsets arrive within five minutes

Organization plan is navapbc Free (20 total / 5 macOS concurrent jobs); repository-local queue depth measured at 22 waiting jobs and 15 running jobs during 2026-08-15 burst suggests shared-org contention beyond this repository alone

Four mutually exclusive first-move options exist: (A) reduce immediate fan-out to 10 and cap mutation to 3 lanes (recommended); (B) coalesce superseded patchsets via debounce (low value, 78–110s savings per replacement); (C) move macOS pre-merge to scheduled health (9–11m latency win but weakens pre-merge coverage); (D) upgrade organization plan to Team (60 concurrent slots, recurring cost)
